purpose: Connect the frozen 20-session prediction scores to a post-cost ledger: on the same fixed 20-session grid, variant A rebalances to target weight 1 and variant B to clip(H3/H1, 0, 1) using the stored predict-h20-v3 forecasts. Identical ledger mechanics, deposits, fills, fees, ticks, valuation and inter-grid cash handling for both. Descriptive comparison of two ledgers; the weight ratio is a heuristic proposed after viewing results, not an optimal allocation; no orders.

weights.decision_sessions: the 146 grid decisions i = 3031 + 20k of predict-h20-v3 (2014-12-30 .. 2026-10-28); the pending block (decision 2026-10-28) trades normally and is marked to the cutoff
weights.B_ratio: w_i = clip(H3_i / H1_i, 0, 1) with H3_i = stored mu_hat_H3 and H1_i = stored anchor_mu_loaded.H1 at decision i; both are 20-session simple-return means in the same unit; no daily h enters the weight
weights.guard: H1_i > 0 for all 146 decisions and both values finite; any violation aborts invalid_input before any ledger step (no fallback weight)
weights.between_grid_decisions: no trades; deposits accumulate as idle cash (yield 0) and are deployed at the next grid execution by both variants identically; weights are not recomputed off-grid

ledger_mechanics.inherits: allocate-v1 spec 8d8c5946 timeline, applied identically to A and B
ledger_mechanics.period: sessions from the first grid decision 2014-12-30 (index 3031) through the cutoff 2026-11-05 (index 5937): 2907 sessions, 2907 deposits of 10,000 won, 146 scheduled rebalances
ledger_mechanics.timeline: session i: if a weight is pending from the previous close (only when i-1 was a grid decision), observe raw O[i], compute W_open = cash + qty*O[i], target_qty = floor(w*W_open/O[i]), trade at O[i]+5 (buy) or O[i]-5 (sell) with fee floor(notional*15/100000) on integer won notional, cash cap incl. fee; then observe close, deposit 10,000, record the daily row; the first session has no trade; the last session executes nothing new
ledger_mechanics.sell_rule: target_qty < qty -> sell (qty - target_qty) at O-5 minus fee
ledger_mechanics.buy_rule: target_qty > qty -> buy min(target_qty - qty, largest affordable q incl. fee) at O+5
ledger_mechanics.final_position: mark remaining shares at the final raw close; no forced liquidation; report final cash, shares and marked equity separately
ledger_mechanics.costs: fees and ticks are booked in cash; turnover_won, tick_cost_won and fees_total_won reported as diagnostics only, never subtracted twice
ledger_mechanics.pnl: value - cumulative deposits; max drawdown on (value - deposits) with running peak from 0
ledger_mechanics.exposure: qty*C/value after the deposit; mean over the unique daily rows

paired: B minus A of (value - deposits) at the period end
min and max of the daily B minus A difference
number of sessions where B held fewer shares than A
yearly increments of (value - deposits) for A and B and their difference (descriptive, calendar year of the session)

verification_required: 5-session hand fixture (flat prices) reproducing the allocate-v1 integer fee/tick arithmetic to the won

grid fixture (step 3): no trades between grid executions, idle cash accumulates and is deployed at the next grid; clip behaviour at ratio < 0 (w = 0, full sale), 0 < ratio < 1 (partial), ratio > 1 (w = 1); H1 <= 0 or non-finite aborts before any ledger step

mechanics regression on real data: the same ledger engine in daily full-weight mode (step 1, w = 1) must reproduce ladder R1 anchors on common / bull_2025 / crash_2026 to the won (pnl, buys, sells, max_dd, deposits, qty_end, final_value); this is the only real-data ledger computation allowed in selftest

perturbation: changing raw O/C strictly after session k leaves all trades and daily rows through k unchanged; weights depend only on stored predictions (changing a stored H3 at decision m changes trades only from execution m+1 onward)
anchor alignment: 146 stored decisions match the grid calendar (index, session, entry); H3/H1 finite; H1 > 0; rejection tests for duplicate, shifted, missing, non-finite and H1 <= 0
invariants: cash never negative, integer non-negative qty, self-financing cash change equals signed notional minus fee, equity change at execution equals tick loss plus fee
constant-price full payload; input validation (integer won, sorted unique sessions, array alignment)
real selftest: hashes, calendar, anchor metadata and the R1 mechanics regression only; no A/B ledger on real data before the approved run; bill reviews the final code hash

mixing daily h or any other series into the weight
